What games can play on my laptop?

A lot of Valve games are pretty well optimized for lower end hardware. You should be able to play CS, Half-Life, Portal, TF2 no problem. Dota is a bit heavier on hardware, but should still be playable. League will run better. Of course, none of these games will be the prettiest on that system, but they'll be fine for daily use.
Yup. I played LOL and that runs pretty good. However, DOTA does not run that well.

Intel HD 4400 isn't a bad graphics card but most games will run fairly poorly unless you play at resolutions much much lower than your screens native resolution to keep the framerate stable with intensive games.

An old trick to play games on weaker hardware is to play at the lowest resolution possible (640x480 or 800x600) and set to high or turn on whatever image options that don't cause the framerate to go below about 30fps, then use a high anti-aliasing filter to claw back some image quality and hide the low resolutions, you'd be surprised just what games go from completely unplayable to fully playable and have a high framerate along side some pretty FX.
Half Life 2, Portal 2, Left 4 Dead 2 should all run okay.
